summary: BUG - Auto Pick doubles picked quantity on approval and corrupts inventory on return
reported_issue: With Auto Pick enabled, approving a quoted part request picks double the requested quantity (e.g. request 4 of SV029 picks 8). Returning restores only 4, leaving inventory short. Occurs in both Part Sales and Work Orders; disabling Auto Pick makes it behave correctly.
expected_after_fix: System picks 4 and returns 4, restoring inventory accurately.
steps_i_followed: Read org settings: found the relevant flag 'autoPickInventoryParts' = false (Auto Pick was OFF by default on this shop). The reported bug only manifests when Auto Pick is ENABLED.
Enabled Auto Pick: POST /api/organizations/settings/change {autoPickInventoryParts:true}; verified it read back as true.

Searched for the required repro state - an UNAPPROVED core INVENTORY part on a WO line - to approve and observe the pick quantity. Global /api/parts records were all status 'Authorized' (already approved); the only unapproved 'Requested' parts found (WO S9-24075) were quoted, non-inventory-linked parts with '(-)' part numbers, which do not exercise the inventory auto-pick path.

Attempted to build the state on disposable data: Work Order S9-24075 > New Line > Save & Add Part to add a core inventory part with qty 4, then approve with Auto Pick on and read the picked quantity / inventory delta.
Restored the setting: POST /api/organizations/settings/change {autoPickInventoryParts:false}; verified false.
actual_now: Could not reach a FIXED/STILL-REPRODUCES determination. Confirmed the pre-condition matters (Auto Pick default OFF; enabled it successfully). However the required repro state (an unapproved, inventory-linked core part on a WO line, then approved) could not be constructed: no such existing record was found, and the New Line > Save & Add Part create flow did not advance in the harness - the 'What Are You Doing?' field is a canned-job combobox that validation-blocks free-typed values, so 'Save & Add Part' fired no create request (consistent with the documented session quirk that create-* flows are unreliable here). Without an approvable core inventory part I could not observe the pick quantity (4 vs 8) or the inventory delta.
notes: Actionable to close out: with Auto Pick enabled, add a real core INVENTORY part (received, with a part number) to a WO line or Part Sale as an unapproved/quoted request of qty N (e.g. 4), approve it, and confirm picked qty == N (not 2N) and inventory drops by N; then return and confirm inventory restores by N. Blocker here was purely building the unapproved-core-inventory-part state via the harness-flaky create/add-part UI, not the fix itself. autoPickInventoryParts was restored to false after testing.
